method.predicted_skyline: web/js/visibility.js skyline(), 0.1 deg azimuth, maxRange 2500 m, DEM web/data/dem.f32 (2.5 x 2.5 km window, 1 m)
method.real_skyline: Navcam left B full-frame EDR JPEGs; sky/terrain boundary traced per column (see validation/README.md), sampled every 8 px; pixel to direction via the CAHVOR model and rover attitude quaternion published with each image
method.window_limited_rule: horizon point within 100 m of where the ray leaves the DEM window
method.tuning: none; no model parameter was changed or fitted

rover_position.source: route.json waypoint (MMGIS MSL_waypoints) for this site_drive
